diagnosis: The Cloudflare Worker edge controller routes smart lock unlock commands directly to a Durable Object actor identified by lockId without consulting Cloudflare D1 or checking user property ownership. While the client must provide an Authorization token, any authenticated user can send an unlock command for any smart lock in the system, causing unauthorized physical entry and severe security breaches.
